title: Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) — Documentation of Riverbend's Own Charges on Medical Hardship Applications
content:
## Scope

Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), Riverbend documents on a Medical Hardship application with no outside medical bills document accepted on it the qualifying medical debt of its own charges, starting from the medical debt claimed on the case and valuing Riverbend's self-pay charges of the twelve whole months before the documentation day at the financial assistance charge basis: amounts generally billed for emergency and medically necessary care, never above the bill as posted, as billed for elective care.

A case with an outside medical bills document accepted is not documented under this schedule: its qualifying medical debt is the documented medical bills, Riverbend and outside, incurred in the last debt-window months (the hardship debt window of the tier) before the application date.

**The qualifying medical debt is documented only once the case records a medical debt the patient claims (a case showing 0.00 records none).** Put the other way, a case whose medical debt reads 0.00 has no claimed medical debt on record, and nothing is documented on it under this schedule while it reads so.

## The medical hardship test

Medical hardship above 400 percent FPL applies only when, for an application whose qualifying medical debt is recorded under Riverbend's hardship schedules (claimed on a hardship supplement or on a renewal's claim of medical debt, or documented under Riverbend's documentation schedules for its own charges and for other medical costs) and on which no outside medical bills document has been accepted, and only for such an application, the qualifying medical debt recorded on the case, counted as those schedules state as of their signing or documentation day, exceeds the hardship medical debt percent of the tier of annual household income; for every other application, including one with an outside medical bills document accepted, the qualifying medical debt — the documented medical bills (Riverbend and outside) incurred in the last debt-window months before the application date — exceeds that same percent of annual household income.

## Recording the documented figure: `record_qualifying_debt_da5f54be`

The agent unlocks `record_qualifying_debt_da5f54be` and then calls it. It records, as a financial counselor, on a financial assistance case the qualifying medical debt that Riverbend has documented for its own charges. The case's qualifying medical debt figure is replaced by the documented amount; status, tier, dates and the other household figures stay as they are. The counselor and the patient can see the documented figure on the case.

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `fap_case_id` | the reference number of the financial assistance case being documented, as shown by the financial assistance case lookup for the patient |
| `qualifying_medical_debt_usd` | the documented qualifying medical debt, in USD — a non-negative amount stated to 2 decimal places (cents), stored rounded half-up to 2 decimal places |

Return: "Qualifying medical debt documented on case <case>: <amount> USD." The amount carries 2 decimal places; the receipt appearing means the figure is on the case.
